Tess (release): Noticed an uptick of transient 504s in na-west for high-concurrency summarization jobs after runtime 3.6.0 landed. Suggest short regional routing pin to 3.5.4 while runtime investigates.
Arjun (runtime): I'm seeing worker stalls tied to a new scheduling heuristic in 3.6.0 under high multi-tenant pressure. No memory corruption, but request queue starvation can cause timeouts.
Keenan (qa): Repro: spin 12 clients, long prompt streams ~15k tokens, p99 timeouts reproducible in ~2-3 minutes on 3.6.0. Stack snippet: ```
W scheduler.cc:278 - schedule delay exceeded threshold
I worker_pool.cc:412 - draining stalled worker
```
Maya (sdk): If we do a regional pin please ensure routing doesn't mix runtimes for the same model route. I can push a route-lock for model_group=summary-* scoped to na-west. Will include Console banner and audit.
Pri (cs): Affected customers flagged their dashboards; if we can mitigate regionally that helps buy time for a proper fix. I'll prepare a short customer note.
Tess (release): Proposed: deploybot apply a 90m soft-pin runtime=3.5.4 for model_group=summary-* in na-west; SDK apply per-route runtime-lock; runtime runs canary and instrument scheduler; QA validates smoke. Any objections?
Arjun (runtime): Fine. I'll run a 60-request canary across seq lengths and concurrency profiles once pin is active.
Maya (sdk): I'll push override now. deploybot, schedule apply in 3m with 5m cooldown and include rollback runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/runtime-rollback.
deploybot: Request received:
  action: soft-pin
  runtime: 3.5.4
  model_filter: group=summary-*
  scope: region=na-west
  window: 90m
  cooldown: 5m
  initiated_by: Tess (release)
deploybot: Running preflight checks...
ci-bot: Preflight: routing graph OK; capacity headroom: 15% in na-west; no blocking hotfixes.
Maya (sdk): Override applied. Console label: "na-west-runtime-lock-6612345678"; audit id: a9f3-rtlock.
Keenan (qa): Post-pin smoke: 20-minute run with mixed concurrency, no timeouts, queues stable.
Arjun (runtime): Canary: 60 requests, median latency +3ms, p95 +10ms, no stalls. Scheduler metrics show reduced head-of-line waits with 3.5.4.
Tess (release): OK. Keep triage channel open. If runtime patch is low-risk we'll coordinate a 3.6.1 to address the scheduling heuristic and lift the pin. Pri (cs) will send customer note. Closing thread when pin is lifted or we escalate. :white_check_mark:
